article.story: CHICAGO -- — Will Berg's 27 points helped Wichita State defeat Loyola Chicago 79-75 on Wednesday. Berg added nine rebounds for the Shockers (4-1). Dillon Battie added 13 points while shooting 3 of 8 from the field and 6 for 6 from the line while they also had eight rebounds. Jahari Long had eight points and went 3 of 7 from the field. Ryan Agarwal led the way for the Ramblers (3-2) with 22 points and four steals. Loyola Chicago also got 14 points from Jason Schofield. Chris Jeffrey finished with 11 points and six assists. Wichita State turned a two-point second-half lead into a 10-point advantage with a 9-1 run to make it a 68-58 lead with 6:59 left in the half. Berg scored 10 second-half points. Up next Wichita State's next game is Saturday against New Mexico at home. Loyola Chicago takes on San Jose State on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
